sum_of_rdist_eq_char_2.statement: Let $G$ be a finite abelian group that is a module over $\mathbb Z/2\mathbb Z$ (i.e. $2g=0$ for all $g\in G$), equipped with a measurable structure in which singletons are measurable. Let $(\Omega,\mu)$ be a measurable space with a probability measure $\mu$, and let $Y_0,Y_1,Y_2,Y_3:\Omega\to G$ be measurable random variables that are jointly independent under $\mu$. Then, all quantities being taken with respect to $\mu$, $$d[Y_0;Y_1]+d[Y_2;Y_3]=d[Y_0+Y_2;\,Y_1+Y_3]+d[Y_0\mid Y_0+Y_2;\,Y_1\mid Y_1+Y_3]+I[Y_0+Y_1:Y_1+Y_3\mid Y_0+Y_1+Y_2+Y_3],$$ where $d[X;Y]=H[X'-Y']-H[X]/2-H[Y]/2$ is the Ruzsa distance (entropy $H$ of the difference of independent copies $X',Y'$ of $X,Y$), $d[X\mid Z;Y\mid W]$ is the conditional Ruzsa distance, and $I[X:Y\mid Z]$ is the conditional mutual information $\int \big(H[X\mid Z=z]+H[Y\mid Z=z]-H[(X,Y)\mid Z=z]\big)\,d(Z_*\mu)(z)$.
